newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.142 billion yuan from 1.161 billion last Friday with the 30-day contract the most active.
Traders said some short-term financial centres (money brokerages run by the central bank), including those in Beijing and Dalian, continued to buy while other centres sold.
"Short-term centres have become key traders recently while major state banks have curtailed their trading since the peak cash demand period at Chinese New Year," one trader said.
"Today's corrections on the domestic A share market made non-bank financial institutions cut their buying," a second trader said. "But tomorrow's three new A share issues will support the rates."
